provide

提供所需的资源、服务、信息或支持。

provide something；provide somebody with something；provide something for somebody；provide evidence / support / training / access。

Both provide intensive coaching, training facilities and nutritional advice.

Both 指前文的 Australian Institute of Sport（AIS，澳大利亚体育学院）和 Australian Sports Commission（ASC，澳大利亚体育委员会）两个机构；原句说二者都提供教练指导、训练设施和营养建议。

原文：

Australia’s Sporting Success

日常语境例句

Schools should provide students with regular feedback and opportunities to practise independently.

学校应该向学生提供经常性的反馈和独立练习的机会。

常用基本结构不是 provide somebody something，可改 provide somebody with something 或 give somebody something。提供机会可用 provide opportunities；提出论点本身不等于 provide evidence。provided (that) 表示只要，是另一种结构。
